method.radial: hydrogen-like radial functions with Slater-rule Z_eff
method.contour: every radial and angular nodal region normalized to its own peak (s, p, d, f)
method.volume: adaptive voxel estimate per radial region above the lobe-normalized display cutoff
method.lobe_normalization: local radial peak times local polar peak; azimuthal sectors have equal peaks
method.interpretation: display normalization only; physical probability density and nodes are unchanged
method.lobe_sampling: uniform baseline plus support points where needed to reach 16 in every connected lobe
method.border_gradient: within each lobe, sample proportional to H**t-1; t=clip(1-distance/(0.2*lobe_depth), 0, 1)
method.border_sampling: visual coverage proportional to surface_area**0.75, balancing surface fill and outline continuity; preserve baseline
method.border_surface_area: marching tetrahedra of the continuous contour, including all inner and outer surfaces
method.border_distance_grid: 128 + 32*l per axis per radial region, independent of volume resolution; approximate signed Euclidean distance
method.gltf_orbital_nodes: GLB/glTF exports contain one named point-cloud node per orbital
